summary: The PR correctly implements the requested feature and includes a regression test. The implementation is clean and follows the existing patterns in the wikilinks extension.

requirements.requirement: Support [[Target|text]] syntax in the wikilinks extension.
The part before | builds the URL exactly like it does today.
The part after | is the text of the link.
Plain [[Target]] should keep working exactly as now.

dropped.description: The PR correctly implements the requested feature to support [[Target|text]] syntax in the wikilinks extension. It also maintains backward compatibility for [[Target]] syntax. The implementation uses partition('|') to split the target and text, which is robust. The tests confirm the functionality.
